name: Ishura
description: A host of demigods have inherited the world after the Demon King has died, and a battle to determine the mightiest ensues.

videos.title: Soujirou the Willow-Sword
videos.overview: Numerous golems emerge in the city. Amidst the chaos, a swordsman, Soujirou Yagyuu, appears.

videos.title: Alus the Star Runner
videos.overview: A spy comes under attack, and a certain military officer attempts to slay a dragon.

videos.title: Dakai the Magpie and Regnejee the Wings of Sunset
videos.overview: Dakai the Magpie searches for a traitor, while Regnejee searches for a rule-breaker.

videos.title: Nihilo the Vortical Stampede and Kia the World Word
videos.overview: Hidow the Clamp releases a notorious figure, and Elea the Red Tag infiltrates an elf village.

videos.title: Higuare the Pelagic and Nastique the Quiet Singer
videos.overview: Higuare the Pelagic and Shalk the Sound Slicer meet with Taren the Guarded.

videos.title: Gathering of Factions
videos.overview: Soujirou and Yuno are tasked by Hidow the Clamp with a consequential mission.

videos.title: War Commences
videos.overview: Yuno the Distant Talon and Soujirou the Willow-Sword are attacked by deadly assassins from Lithia.

videos.title: The New Demon King War
videos.overview: Yuno the Distant Talon discovers the person responsible for a certain tragedy and vows her revenge.

videos.title: Fire From the Sky
videos.overview: Soujirou encounters a worthy opponent, while Alus the Star Runner gets surrounded by wyverns.

videos.title: Vanishing Calamity
videos.overview: Elea and Kia search for Lana the Moon Tempest, and Dakai confronts Nihilo the Vortical Stampede.

videos.title: When the Sun Sets
videos.overview: Regnejee the Wings of Sunset tries to help Curte of the Fair Skies escape.

videos.title: Shura
videos.overview: The shura head to Aureatia, each with their own motives.

videos.title: Mele the Horizon's Roar
videos.overview: A young boy visits Mele the Horizon's Roar, while Kuuro the Cautious is on the run in Toghie City.

videos.title: Linaris the Obsidian
videos.overview: Kuuro the Cautious searches for a traitor. Elsewhere, Shirok the Sextant meets a beautiful girl.

videos.title: Toroa the Awful and Mestelexil the Box of Desperate Knowledge
videos.overview: Elgite the Ochre Haze sets out to steal enchanted swords while Mestelexil fights another golem.

videos.title: Atrazek the Particle Storm, Part One
videos.overview: Toroa the Awful offers to fight for the Old Kingdom as Kiyazuna the Axle pursues the Particle Storm.

videos.title: Atrazek the Particle Storm, Part Two
videos.overview: Toroa the Awful confronts Mestelexil the Box of Desperate Knowledge as the Particle Storm nears.

videos.title: Rosclay the Absolute
videos.overview: Jelki the Swift Ink grants Gilnes a chance to fight for justice in a duel.

videos.title: Lucnoca the Winter and Psianop the Inexhaustible Stagnation
videos.overview: Harghent the Still and Lagrex the Butchering Landslide seek a dragon. Elsewhere, an ooze appears.

videos.title: Uhak the Silent
videos.overview: Cunodey the Ring Seat, an oracle of the Religious Order, joins an expedition to hunt down an ogre.

videos.title: Kazuki the Black Tone
videos.overview: Yukiharu the Twilight Diver encounters deadly mercenaries. At Okahu, a legendary gunner approaches.

videos.title: Tu the Magic
videos.overview: Rique the Misfortune and Krafnir the Hatch of Truth attempt to find the Demon King's child.

videos.title: Hiroto the Paradox
videos.overview: Yukiharu is targeted by mercenaries and Hiroto the Paradox visits the leader of Okahu.

videos.title: Shiki, Enemy of All
videos.overview: Twenty-one years ago, the First Party confronted the True Demon King. Why did they fail?
